value.rationale: The source highlights the one-leaf equality and asks how generalized Morse complexes can inform ordinary Morse complexes. Extending that leaf by a single edge on the smallest cycle in the source theorem is a canonical boundary test, and the resulting Betti-rank split gives a concrete obstruction to naively extending the equality.
risks: No general length-two-tail family theorem is claimed; the structural mechanism behind the split remains open.
